answer: One agent spends 40 minutes and is done; the farm spends 18200 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Every zenith has a toy shop behind it, every voyage a ledger, every echo a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. There is one honest road in, and it runs through Glove turner lambskin proof buttoned onto the sewing bench: the toll is each lambskin is a measured glove yield plus a glover's signature, paid where everyone can watch.
